models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
symptoms: Difficulties with starting a cold engine.
Starting the engine when engine is warmish or warm, idle rpm immediately is 1200 - 3000 rpm.
With all engine temperatures seldom idle rpm will vary between 900 - 1000 rpm.
With engine warm (90 °C) the engine temperature suddenly drops (70 °C) and slowly comes back to 90 °C.

Bad acceleration during warming up.
Diesel: an indication is extreme long time burning time of the glow indication light.

technicalNotes: In MY 1995-2002 (?) in Europe at VW-cars the G2/G62 had the bad reputation of breaking down often. The default G2/G62 is black and all replacements are green.
